dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady, acute geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a sharp point at the visible limit of the tail base.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely symmetrical lateral margins with a smooth, continuous curve; no significant bulges or indentations visible at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with very light grey undertones; high reflectance along the central dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, low-contrast parallel linear marks (rake marks) on the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle, healed linear rake marks are visible across the mid-dorsal region.
